name: mcbrain
description: Build and operate McBrain — a persistent, LLM-maintained personal knowledge base based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Bundles four cooperating skills: one-shot vault setup, day-to-day vault operations (ingest/query/lint/synth), Notion research-tracker creation (registered back into the vault), and a queue runner that drains research tasks and writes findings back to Notion.
